series_books.title: The Naturalization Interview & Immigration Medical Exam Guide
series_books.subtitle: What to Bring, What Happens in the Room and How to Find a Civil Surgeon, Step by Step
series_books.description:
Two appointments make many people nervous on the way to a green card and citizenship: the immigration medical exam with a civil surgeon, and the naturalization interview. This guide walks you through both in plain words so you arrive with the right papers and know what will happen.

Inside:
- The immigration medical exam: who a civil surgeon is, how to find one, what to bring, what happens at the visit and the sealed form afterwards
- Vaccination records and what to gather before you book
- The naturalization interview: the day in order, from security to the decision paper
- Practising for the English and civics parts, with a study plan
- Answering questions about your application honestly and calmly
- What to bring, a packing checklist and a log for your appointments and mail
- Where to get free or low-cost legal help, and how to avoid scams

Not affiliated with U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services or any government agency. Educational only; not legal or medical advice. Every case is different; for advice about yours, speak to an immigration attorney or an accredited representative.

Published by Spry Labs.
